content.short: Minteo issues local currency stablecoins for Latin America and runs settlement for remittances and payouts.
content.description: Minteo issues COPM, a Colombian peso stablecoin, and settles remittances, payouts and foreign exchange against it alongside USDC, with Mexican, Chilean and Peruvian versions planned. Holding a token denominated in the local currency rather than dollars matters for businesses whose costs are local, since it removes a conversion step and the spread that comes with it. Reserves are held one to one at regulated financial institutions, audited monthly by BDO, and the contracts have been through external security review. The company is based in Colombia.
